=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:3388-3401,3573 (with scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:18,81) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: implement_engine_display_name() returns "Codex" only when the claude-implement.unavailable marker exists, but the heal route (heal_isolated_implement.sh) falls back to Codex without writing that marker, so logs and diagnostics still say "Claude".
  WHY: Operators are misinformed about the active engine, which is the mislabel this PR sets out to remove. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated NIT, gemini rated MAJOR; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:4028,4030,5012 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Status messages still hard-code "Codex" ("Posted Codex implement failure diagnostics", "Could not post Codex failure diagnostics", and at line 5012 the post-Codex repair message) instead of using ${implement_engine_name}.
  WHY: A Claude run prints "Claude implement failed after N attempts" and then "Posted Codex implement failure diagnostics", which is inconsistent and confusing. Sonnet and qwen cited 4028/4030 and called them NIT. Gemini cited 4028/4030/5012 and rated the log finding NIT and its task-gap MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:418-423,2152-2178 (triggers: .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1664, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:1077, scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:430, orchestrate.yml:997-1025, implement.yml:4036) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The engine-specific "Claude"/"Codex" word in `::error::` lines and orchestrate `last_status` changes the heal error signature, because normalize_error_line() lowercases the text but keeps the engine word.
  WHY: Recurrences get new fingerprints, which breaks dedupe and the WORKFLOW_HEAL_MAX_LINEAGE_DEPTH cap, and failures that alternate between engines split across fingerprints. Severity disagreement: sonnet, luna and qwen rated MAJOR, gemini rated BLOCKER; the highest is used.
- tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py:480 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: In _decomposer_engine_branches(), run.index('if [ "${ORCHESTRATE_ENGINE}" = "claude" ]; then') now matches the new one-line orchestrate_engine_name assignment instead of the real Claude launch branch.
  WHY: The anchor is wrong, so the tests inspect a wider region than intended and could hide a regression in the real branch.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
